name: RF-Swift
description: Multi-platform RF toolbox with 15+ specialized container images for SDR, telecom, Bluetooth, WiFi, and more.

docker_support.docker_evidence: RF Swift supports both Docker and Podman as container engines. Multiple pre-built OCI-compatible container images. 15+ specialized images (SDR, telecom, Bluetooth, WiFi, RFID, automotive). GPU acceleration and USB passthrough support.

eval_notes: Container-first RF toolbox. Telecom-specific images include cellular protocol tools. Good for SDR and RF signal analysis evals.
